messages.author: aishen
messages.body:
Hello dear amber20's ,
I am french and I wondering if amber has been translated to french or if
any tentative has been done in this way ?
I make some jupyter notebook from the english tutorial would it be
interesting to have them in french ?
I started amber20 about 2 months ago and it was a real pain to configure
everything... For example xleap is unreadable on ubuntu linux, fonts are
grey, but I found a way to overcome this with tleap. Is there really a
difference between xleap and tleap ? If so which one ?
The problem of translating it 's it takes a lot of times and I am not
sure it can be interesting to other people, I translated in french
visitII and after few months I noticed it was not really interesting
because all tutorials or projects are in english !! At this level of
specialization it's not evident to see if the translated soft is better
or even as good as the original version ?
Thank you for reading me and giving me advices
Best
Henri

messages.author: Dr. Anselm Horn
messages.body:
Dear Henri,
I don't think that there are any plans for a customization of Amber in
other languages: this would multiply the necessary efforts to keep
everything up to date, while the actual needs are minor IMHO.
Today, English has become the Lingua Franca in science, most scientific
publications use English or provide an English translation. Moreover, it
is used (in phrases or technical terms) in almost all areae of modern
life in other languages, too.
The issues you faced on your computer may probably be resolved via
careful configuration. Many people on this list are willing to help and
to share their experience; but they need a detailed description of the
problem to do so.
All the best,
Anselm
